en: Color illustration of a European market square with outdoor stalls and white umbrellas around a central fountain topped by statues. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and German-language shop signs. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a prominent clock tower with a steep roof and two large clock faces, connected to fortification walls and greenery.
